turns.utterance: What is the meaning of the latin word camera obscura?

gold_passages: A camera obscura (plural camerae obscurae or camera obscuras, from Latin camera obscūra, "dark chamber")[1] is a darkened room with a small hole or lens at one side through which an image is projected onto a wall[2][3] or table[4] opposite the hole.[2][3]

The word camera comes from camera obscura, which means "dark chamber" and is the Latin name of the original device for projecting an image of external reality onto a flat surface. The modern photographic camera evolved from the camera obscura.
